title: backlog.py check fails on knowledge refs of items nobody is working on
goal: backlog.py check validates knowledge refs only on items that are todo or doing in an active sprint, so a kb refresh that renames an article a draft, done or dropped item cites does not turn the gate red, and stale knowledge is counted for those items only; a test plants a missing ref on a dropped item

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import backlog as b;bl=b.Backlog('.');i=next(k for k,v in bl.items.items() if v.get('status')=='dropped');bl.items[i]['knowledge']={'refs':['public/no/such-topic']};errs=b.validate(bl);sys.exit(1 if any('such-topic' in str(x) for x in errs) else 0)
